{{Quote|I'm aboard the First Expeditionary Fleet's command ship, the dreadnaught ''Telos''.|[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="Telos" />}}
The '''''Telos''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] as the flagship of the [[First Expeditionary Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Telos" />

It served as the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] during the [[Battle of Taral V|raid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Taral V Imperial fortress|compound]] on [[Taral V]] in order to gain a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Gree computer|computer]] to chart a course into the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]]. It would come to help the Republic strike team by shooting down Imperial bombers trying to destroy the complex. This ship along with the rest of the Expeditionary fleet jumped to the secret Imperial prison to [[Battle of the Maelstrom|rescue]] Jedi Master [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] as they held off the Imperial warships defending the station. The ship was saved by a tactical retreat during the fight.<ref name="Telos" />
